name: Haulest
description: Plan a home move in the US, Canada, or UK: research cost ranges by home size and distance, movers with dated reviews near a place, one company's profile with its licence record, USDOT, MC, or Companies House lookup with the official record, guides and checklists, and a consent-gated quote request to licensed movers. 8 tools, 7 read-only. No authentication. Haulest is a research and quote site, not a carrier; cost figures are planning ranges, not bids.
author: Panaweb-LLC
